dcterms:description: A dataset consisting of collected messages from Twitter in English and Spanish for hate speech detection. The English data contains 10,000 messages with 42.1% labeled as hate speech, while the Spanish data contains 4,969 messages with 41.5% labeled as hate speech, totaling 14,969 messages with 6,270 categorized as hate speech.
dcterms:title: Multilingual Hate Speech Detection Dataset
